[[Kolleen Redstone]] is a collector, a type of NPC that exchanges [[trophy|trophies]] for other items.

During the defense of the Temple of the Ages (part of the quest [[Deactivating R.O.X.]]), Kolleen puts on battle gear (see image).

:''"I'm searching for 4 [[Decayed Orr Emblem]]s. I can offer you one of the following [[item]]s in exchange. Can you help me?"''
